faq.q: Is a root canal painful?
faq.a: The area is numbed first, so the procedure is usually no more uncomfortable than a filling. Some soreness afterwards is common.

faq.q: How often should I get a dental check up?
faq.a: Most people benefit from a check up and cleaning every six months, though your dentist may suggest a different gap.

faq.q: At what age can children visit the dentist?
faq.a: As soon as the first teeth appear. Early visits help parents learn how to care for milk teeth.

faq.q: How long do braces treatment take?
faq.a: It depends on the case. The dentist will give an estimate after examining your teeth and discussing your options.

faq.q: Are your instruments sterilised?
faq.a: Yes. Instruments are cleaned and sterilised between patients, and single use items are discarded.

faq.q: How many sessions of laser hair removal do I need?
faq.a: It varies with hair type and area. The doctor will estimate after examining your skin, and results differ between people.

faq.q: Can acne be treated in one visit?
faq.a: Acne usually needs a course of treatment and follow ups. The doctor will explain what to expect for your skin.

faq.q: Is laser safe for Indian skin?
faq.a: The doctor assesses your skin type before any laser treatment and chooses settings accordingly. Discuss any concerns at consultation.

faq.q: Do I have to buy a package?
faq.a: No. You decide after the consultation, and the doctor will explain which steps are really needed.

faq.q: What should I bring to my first visit?
faq.a: Bring any earlier prescriptions or reports, and a list of products you currently use on your skin.

faq.q: Will I have to give up my favourite foods?
faq.a: Not usually. We work with the foods you enjoy and adjust portions and frequency to fit your goal.

faq.q: How fast will I lose weight?
faq.a: Healthy change is gradual and differs between people. We aim for steady habits instead of quick fixes.

faq.q: Can you help with medical conditions like diabetes?
faq.a: Yes, we plan meals around such conditions. Please share your reports and keep following your doctor's advice.

faq.q: Do I need to buy supplements?
faq.a: Not as a rule. We focus on food first and recommend supplements only if there is a clear reason.

faq.q: Do you offer online consultations?
faq.a: Yes, consultations and follow ups are available by phone or video call.

faq.q: Do you give vaccinations?

faq.q: Should I bring my earlier reports?
